Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Know what to sell, buy, craft, gather — and what to do next.
Description: FFXIV economy decision support for Dalamud. Ranks selling, buying, crafting and gathering opportunities using Universalis, inventory/Market Board observations, vendor economics and your own trading history. Includes native item-tooltip insights, inventory right-click lookups, unified Opportunities, cashflow/FIFO analytics and personal sales/listing history. No automated buying, selling, repricing or queued native Market Board scanning. The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Changelog: v2.3.3: Correct Universalis history parameter names/units and separate local fetch freshness from upstream upload age. Includes the vendor sell-through sizing fix.
